title: fix(react,fields,charts,dashboard,report,list,core): surface filter refusals at render/click-time merges instead of throwing (objectui#10789)
body:
Fixes #10789
Clause-②: yes

> **Seat note (`domain:ui` seat #1, line rewritten by the seat):** `yes`, not the claim’s `no`. `filterRefusal` is a new optional member on `UseElementDataSourceResult` and `UseElementDataSourceSchemaResult`, both of which are reachable from `@object-ui/react`’s `.` entry through `export *`. That is public-face growth, and the claim amendment on objectui#10789 records it. The acceptance set only narrows.

The render-time and click-time filter merges called the THROWING converter form, so a malformed authored filter threw a `FilterOperatorError` out of render (into the nearest error boundary) or out of a click handler, instead of surfacing the refusal the way the sibling sites already do. Every such site now keeps the refusal as a value and surfaces it on the channel its nearest sibling uses. A malformed filter stays **refused**: nothing refused becomes accepted, and no site falls back to "no filter".

Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat #1 PM; implemented in session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01DuWo5bdP9SdVebamn99GGk`.

## Census (execution note 1)

Every caller of the throwing forms (`convertFiltersToAST`, `toFilterNode`, `mergeFilterNodes`) and of the core utilities that wrap them (`composeElementDataSource`, `composeDrillFilter`, `buildDatasetDrillFilter`, `buildEffectiveFilter`), read on `origin/main` at `a14fb23b3`. Cited by symbol, never by line (AGENTS.md #11).

| # | Site (symbol) | Package | Reaches the converter via | Class on `main` | This PR |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R1 | `useElementDataSourceSchema` — component `filter` AND composed binding | react | `mergeFilterNodes` | **render, uncaught** | each source through `toFilterNodeSafely`; refusal → `status: 'missing'` + `filterRefusal`; `ElementDataSourceGate` draws the malformed-filter notice |
| R2 | `useElementDataSource` → `composeElementDataSource` — view filter AND binding filter | react / core | `mergeFilterNodes` | **render, uncaught** (consumers: `ElementDataSourceGate`, `element:record_picker`) | `FilterOperatorError` caught at the hook → `missing` + `filterRefusal`; gate → notice; record picker → its own configuration-error panel |
| R3 | `PeoplePicker` `recentFilter` | fields | `mergeFilterNodes` | **render, uncaught** — on every render with a declared filter, not only with recents | `toFilterNodeSafely(baseFilter)`; recents query disabled; refusal in the candidate area's error slot |
| R4 | `RecordPickerDialog` `mergedFilter` (rule-array arm) | fields | `mergeFilterNodes` | **render, uncaught** | each side through `toFilterNodeSafely`; query disabled; refusal in the dialog's error alert |
| R5 | `ObjectChart` `drillFilter` | plugin-charts | `composeDrillFilter` | **render after a click, uncaught** | caught; no drawer, no navigate; `console.warn` naming the operator |
| R6 | `ObjectPivotTable` `renderDrillDrawer` | plugin-dashboard | `composeDrillFilter` | **render after a click, uncaught** | composition memo above the early returns; caught; no drawer, no navigate; `console.warn` |
| R7 | `DatasetWidget` `openDrill` | plugin-dashboard | `buildDatasetDrillFilter` → `composeDrillFilter` | **click handler, uncaught** | caught; no drawer; `console.warn` |
| R8 | `DatasetReportRenderer` row `drill` and matrix `drillCell` | plugin-report | `buildDatasetDrillFilter` → `composeDrillFilter` | **click handler, uncaught** | caught; `onDrill` NOT emitted (never with `objectFilter` absent); `console.warn` |
| R9 | `ListView` `handleExport`, server leg — `buildEffectiveFilter` ran BEFORE the export `try` | plugin-list | `buildEffectiveFilter` → `mergeFilterNodes` | **click handler, uncaught** (found by this census) | moved inside the export `try`; refusal named in the export menu |
| S | `ObjectGrid` `schema.filter`; `RelatedList` list filter; `LineItemsPanel` filter; `ValueDataSource.find` array `$filter` | grid / detail / form / core | `toFilterNodeSafely` | safe | untouched |
| L | `ListView` data fetch; `ListView` self-query filter (own catch); `ObjectView` `finalFilter`; `ObjectGrid` `defaultFilters` leg; `LookupField` recents; `related-count-store` `fetchCount`; data-objectstack `translateFilterToAST` (find, exportDownload) and the SDK `find` leg; `ViewDataProvider.resolveElementDataSource` (async, no production caller) | various | various | inside a load `try` / async | untouched |
| N | `RelatedList` / `LineItemsPanel` `mergeFilterNodes(parentScope, listFilterNode)` | detail / form | `mergeFilterNodes` | cannot refuse: both operands already lowered or producer-built | untouched |
| X | `DrillDownDrawer` report-drill `mergedFilter` | plugin-dashboard | none (literal `$and`) | no converter call | untouched |
| C | `lowerLogicalGroup` `$or` early return (execution note 4) | core | — | refusal depends on member order | every member is read; the TRUE disjunct absorbs after the loop |

### Design choice (brief, zone 2 item 2)

- **Where a site lowers ONE source it owns** (R1, R3, R4): `toFilterNodeSafely` per source, then `mergeFilterNodes` over the lowered nodes — the idiom `RelatedList` and `LineItemsPanel` already use. Re-lowering a lowered node is the identity (`toFilterNode` returns an AST array or `undefined`), so a well-formed filter reaches the wire byte-for-byte as before.
- **Where the lowering sits inside a core utility** (R2, R5–R9): the utilities keep throwing, and their async callers are unchanged. Since patch round 1, `composeDrillFilter` throws one refusal type: the spec `parseFilterAST`'s `INVALID_FILTER` is re-raised as a `FilterOperatorError` with the same envelope, and any other error passes through untouched. The render/click caller catches ONLY `FilterOperatorError` — the rule `toFilterNodeSafely` states; anything else is rethrown.
- **No new export.** `@object-ui/core` gains nothing; `@object-ui/react` gains one optional field, `filterRefusal`, on the two binding-hook result types (see Acceptance notes).
- **The notice per site (zone 2 item 4), matched to the nearest sibling:**
  - gate (R1/R2) — the malformed-filter notice the wrapped blocks draw (`view.malformedFilter`, amber `role="alert"`, the refused operator in a separately addressable headline, the refusal's message beneath), with the gate's `testId` stem. Since patch round 1 its provider-less default is a literal inline `defaultValue`, held byte-identical to the pack by `check:i18n-keys`; the gate imports no `en` pack;
  - record picker (R2) — its own configuration-error panel, reached through `missing`;
  - pickers (R3/R4) — the error slot a refusal from `dataSource.find` already lands in; Retry hidden for a refusal (nothing was read);
  - drills (R5–R8) — no rendered notice exists in any drill surface, so none was invented: the refusal is logged (`console.warn`), the channel `ReportView`'s drill failure and `ValueDataSource`'s refused filter already use. Since patch round 1 this covers both refusal steps: the converter's, and the spec `parseFilterAST`'s `INVALID_FILTER`, which `composeDrillFilter` re-raises as a `FilterOperatorError` (any other error passes through untouched), so the four sites catch it with the catch they already had;
  - export (R9) — the export menu's existing alert.

## Evidence

> **Seat note (`domain:ui` seat #1), patch round 1.** The head is `6f4bee846`. It answers contract review `5858758764` (the pack-object importer gate and the drill seam) and follows dev report `5859112009`. Red leg 2 checked out `drill-down.ts` at `664305cb3` and kept the new pins: `Tests 9 failed | 13 passed (22)`, the 9 reds being exactly the spec-refusal assertions. The readings below are round 1's, at `664305cb3`.

Nine new pin files: eight at round 1, one malformed filter per site plus a well-formed CONTROL per file; patch round 1 added the core drill-seam pin `drill-filter-spec-refusal-10789.test.ts`, and a spec-refusal case in each drill-site pin. Assertions are the notice's content (the refused operator) or the refusal envelope (`code` `INVALID_FILTER`, `httpStatus` 400), plus the absence of any unfiltered read — never a bare `toThrow`.

**Red leg (one-shot, not left in the tree).** The implementation was committed first (`9f1d0712e`); the ten source files checked out at the base `a14fb23b3` (on-disk marker count `objectui#10789` = 0 in each), new pins run, then restored with `git checkout HEAD --` and proven by `git diff HEAD` empty plus a hash match of all ten blobs against HEAD:

```text
Test Files  8 failed (8)
     Tests  18 failed | 12 passed (30)
RESTORED: git diff HEAD empty, 10 blobs match HEAD
```

The 18 reds are the 18 site assertions (each fails with the `FilterOperatorError` the site threw, or with the notice absent); the 12 greens are the CONTROLs plus the member order `main` already refused — they pass both ways by design.

Invariance: no type-aware linting is configured (`eslint.config.js` has no `parserOptions` / `projectService`), so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **Public face.** `UseElementDataSourceResult` and `UseElementDataSourceSchemaResult` gain an optional `filterRefusal`, and the `missing` status now also covers "a filter the binding combines is refused". Chosen over a new status value because every existing consumer already withholds its query on `missing` — a consumer that has not learned the new field still cannot widen. The PM's `Clause-②: no` rests on "no public face grows"; this additive optional field is flagged for that reading.
- **`lowerLogicalGroup` (execution note 4)** narrows, never widens: `{ $or: [{}, { a: {} }] }` is now refused like `{ $or: [{ a: {} }, {}] }` already was; a TRUE disjunct beside members that lower still absorbs (both orders pinned).
- **Drill sites draw no on-screen notice.** No drill surface has a rendered malformed-filter state to match, so the refusal is logged and the drill does not open. An on-screen drill notice would be new UI — left to a decision, not invented here.
- **`element:record_picker`** shows its configuration-error panel (headline "data source could not be resolved") carrying the refusal's message, rather than the malformed-filter sentence: that panel is its own sibling state, and the gate's notice component is not exported.
- **Observed, not in scope:** `LookupField`'s recents effect catches every error into an empty rail (the main popover query still surfaces a refusal); `DrillDownDrawer`'s report drill composes with a literal `$and` rather than the single sink. None measured through a public door; noted, not filed.
- `RecordPickerDialog.tsx` is shared with this seat's in-flight objectui#10594 (`withoutDeniedFields`); this diff touches only the `mergedFilter` region and the error block's Retry.
